newsitem.title: USA: Odwalla under health dept. investigation.
newsitem.headline: Odwalla under health dept. investigation.

text.p: The California Department of Health said on Thursday it is investigating four cases in California of illness possibly linked to unpasteurized apple juice products produced by beverage group Odwalla Inc.
Earlier, Odwalla said that it had recalled some of its products.

The Health Department said that specialists are currently at the company's manufacturing plant in Dinuba and are working with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration and Odwalla to identify the source of any contamination.

The department said that an epidemiological investigation conducted by the Seattle-King County Department of Public Health and the Washington State Department of Health showed that at least ten out of 13 patients with E. coli illness there had consumed Odwalla brand apple juice in the Seattle area.
